invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null Iterator, either from super.handleUpdate or from Collections.singletonList(...).iterator().
partitionPath is a method parameter and is used to access project code without null check.
fileId is used in log messages and partitioner.getSmallFileIds().contains(fileId) without null check.
recordItr is passed into downstream API objects and methods that do not perform null checking.
